propositions: BindingRepository must preserve exact byte layout, sorted/indented JSON with trailing newlines, and round-trip legacy/unknown-field fixtures identically without eager writes on construction.
Save operations must attempt rotation sidecar write before live file replacement, leaving rotation old and live new with inline floor retained if sidecar persistence fails without raising.
Corrupt live state must raise ValueError and preserve the file; corrupt retired state must fail open with best-effort alerting and preserve the file.
Rotation failure followed by a second successful save must write the retained inline floor from live to the sidecar before live replacement, achieving convergence.
Live file persistence failure must leave live old, retain any earlier successful sidecar/retired writes, clean temporary files, and raise; retired or sidecar failure must also raise.
Alert persistence failure must be swallowed entirely and not alter the result of a successful state-file write operation.
